notes: Blueprint: hip template with the side seam down the middle; red marks a vertical slit lying IN the seam, starting just under the waistband and stopping partway down. Attempt 2 fixed the attempt-1 failure. The opening is now unmistakable: a slightly parted seam bounded by two clearly visible horizontal bar tacks, with plain closed seam above and below, and the front panel entirely clean. Frame is now tight to the seam, the back besom pocket is cropped out and one complete belt loop sits at the top. Clearly distinguishable from the no-front-pockets sibling and from the slant and jeans-arc siblings.
